title: Senda
description: An agent-assisted process discovery tool that connects diagrams to source quotations, clarification answers, and revision history.
seoTitle: Senda | Traceable Process Discovery | Hanif Carroll
seoDescription: Explore an independent process discovery tool that connects BPMN diagrams to source quotations, clarification questions, and human review.
problem: A process conversation can leave sequence, responsibilities, and exceptions unclear, while a finished diagram can hide those gaps.
solution: Built an agent-assisted workflow that records questions and connects diagram elements to source quotations.
Added private projects where people can save clarification answers, review revisions, and authorize an agent to propose changes.
Separated current-process models from future plans, each with its own evidence and revision history.
Stored model and discovery records in atomic revisions and created portable BPMN exports.
result: A synthetic onboarding example moves from seven open questions to zero through three scripted clarification rounds, with twelve cases awaiting human review.

Deployed the private web and agent workflow on Cloudflare and checked account verification, model revisions, exports, and revocation on the live service. Evaluation with a real process owner remains ahead.
